thread:
jess: Quick note — onboarding quickstart has copy/paste traps. curl uses `Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API` but Python/Node examples expect `REDWOOD_API_KEY`. New users hit auth errors.
jess: curl currently:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"redwood-v1","input":"hi"}'
```
sam: Yikes. We should standardize on `REDWOOD_API_KEY`. I'll open a small PR to update curl and SDK snippets and add an `export REDWOOD_API_KEY="..."` example.
sam: Also the Node quickstart uses a default import which is wrong — should be named `RedwoodClient`.
alex: For Node/TS show both ESM and CJS: `import { RedwoodClient } from 'redwood'` and `const { RedwoodClient } = require('redwood')`. Include apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY.
maria: I'll add a docs CI check that scans quickstart files for `REDWOOD_API_KEY` so we detect future drift. Adding language tags to code fences too.
docs-bot: docs-lint: running on PR 517... snippet-scan: PASS. No markdown errors.

sam: Verified staging, curl single-line and multi-line work when env is exported. Node CJS/ESM examples ✅.
